summary: Implemented Corvid v2 verification in receiver/signature.py (HMAC-SHA256 over v2:<t>:<event id>:<raw body>, base64-decoded whsec key, 300s-before/60s-after window, multiple v2 elements for rotation, v1 ignored) and changed handle to verify the raw body first (401) before parsing JSON (400). The docs search tool only returned snippets, so a few details (e.g. strict rejection of malformed v2 values) are my reading of the rules.
